title: Great bell of Chion-in
status_note: Struck by a team of monks at New Year (temple).

place.label: Daishōrō bell tower, Chion-in, Kyoto
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

tiers.everyday: Chion-in's great bell in Kyoto was cast in 1636 and weighs about 70 tonnes, one of the largest bells in Japan.
tiers.student: Chion-in gives casting in 1636, 3.3 m high, 2.7 m across and 70 t. It is a bonshō struck from outside with a swinging beam.
